name: What happens if plumbing leaks are discovered behind the drywall during a remodel?

mainEntity.name: What happens if plumbing leaks are discovered behind the drywall during a remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: If an unexpected leak or plumbing issue is uncovered once old bathroom drywall is removed, work stops immediately in that section to resolve the plumbing before new drywall is installed. Covering active leaks or damp framing leads to hidden rot and mold growth behind fresh walls. As an owner-operated general contractor, Abraham Becerra coordinates needed plumbing adjustments with qualified trades, inspects framing for moisture damage, and allows the wall cavity to dry out completely. Once all rough-in lines are tested and sound, drywall installation resumes smoothly without compromising the longevity of the finished bathroom remodel.
acceptedAnswer.description: Drywall installation pauses until plumbing repairs are completed, framing is inspected, and the wall cavity is fully dry before hanging new board.
